item.title: Polyphon AI: Local Meeting Intelligence
item.description: Polyphon AI is an open-source, local-first meeting intelligence engine that captures dual-stream audio, performs real-time and offline speaker diarization, and maintains persistent speaker identities through VoiceDB. It combines low-latency streaming feedback with higher-context post-call reconciliation, then generates self-contained interactive HTML meeting artifacts. Designed for local or private infrastructure, Polyphon AI explores how meeting transcripts can evolve from disposable summaries into a persistent, user-controlled knowledge layer.
